title: AuditEntry
description: One record in the hash-chained, append-only audit log written by audit-ledger. Mirrors the AuthGate HashChainedAudit persisted entry. write-only: never edited after append. Its head is anchored out-of-process (notary) for tamper-EVIDENCE.

seq.description: 0-based, gap-free ordinal. A gap/disorder is a tamper signal.

ts.description: When the entry was recorded (RFC3339 UTC).

verdict.description: The decision recorded. Canonical values are the Decision enum; lowercase allow/deny/transform are accepted for compatibility with the current AuthGate StrEnum and mapped (transform -> LIMIT).

layer.description: Which enforcement layer produced the verdict (capability|purpose|runtime|kernel).

prev_hash.description: sha256 hex of the previous entry (64 zeros for genesis).

entry_hash.description: sha256 hex over the canonical JSON of this entry excluding entry_hash itself.
